facts.business: Samtel India Limited is exploring trading activities in electronic goods and display systems for transport sectors including railways, though currently has no active business operations.
key_risks: Availability of fund is crucial for commencing new business activities
New business activities require due diligence and statutory approvals which can be time consuming
Trading activities may not show good results
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not entered into any transaction as defined u/s 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 with any Related Party during the financial year 2025-26.
